heroHeadline: Iran FA Chief Demands IRGC Guarantee from FIFA — Prestianni Banned from 2 Group Games; 36 Days to Kickoff
heroSubtitle: Iran Football Federation president Mehdi Taj issued a new political condition on May 6: FIFA must provide official guarantees that the United States will not insult the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) before Iran travels to US venues. 'Our host is FIFA, not Mr. Trump or America,' Taj said, confirming a meeting with FIFA President Infantino in Zurich later in May. The demand is near-impossible to meet — the US officially designates the IRGC as a Foreign Terrorist Organization — and comes just days before all 48 nations must submit provisional squad lists to FIFA (May 11 deadline). Iran's federation separately posted World Cup kit photos on May 5, signaling the federation is preparing for the tournament even as the government impasse persists. In a separate ruling, FIFA's Disciplinary Committee extended Argentina winger Gianluca Prestianni's six-game UEFA ban globally (issued May 6): if selected by Scaloni, he would miss Group J's first two matches vs. Algeria (June 17) and Austria (June 21) in Kansas City — his ban stemming from a homophobic slur against Vinicius Junior in a February Champions League match. Brazil's Estevao returned to Palmeiras for hamstring rehabilitation (May 5), keeping his World Cup status in serious doubt alongside Rodrygo (ACL, confirmed out). France squad announcement: May 14. Brazil squad: May 18. USMNT roster: May 26. All 48 nations' final 26-man panels due June 1. 36 days to kickoff at Estadio Azteca.
